routes.retired_because: Objectwise nullity does not determine the coherent cone: the cospan 0 -> Sigma HZ <- 0 has homotopy pullback HZ.

C9000302.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 302 (Radius of comparison equals half the mean dimension.; papers: Filtered products and boundary-preserving compression in complex cobordism; Radius of comparison equals half the mean dimension; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_RADIUS_EQUALITY.statement: For a minimal homeomorphism of an infinite compact metrizable space X, rc(C(X) crossed Z) equals mdim(X,h)/2, including infinity.

C_COHERENT_ADAMS_LIFT.statement: For every pointed CW inclusion G in E, commutative ring spectrum R, stable v: Sigma^infinity E -> Sigma^d S with R-null restriction to G, and 1 <= n <= ell, the restricted smash power on the entire at-least-n-G union lifts through Sigma^(d ell) I_R^smash n. The manuscript assumes finiteness; the proposed proof also covers infinite CW pairs.

C_SIMPLEX_SLICING.statement: The interval-overlap maps Delta^j -> (Delta^j)^ell are continuous and natural for every monotone map, with at most j nonvertex outputs.

C_SLICE_CORE.statement: Interval overlap is additive across adjacent intervals; disjoint equal-width open slices that each contain one of j specified breaks number at most j, in arbitrary finite dimensions.

C_COMPATIBLE_ADAMS_TOWER.statement: For fixed ell and a single chosen R-nullhomotopy on G, the lifts on U_(ell,n), 0<=n<=ell, can be chosen as one homotopy-coherent morphism from the decreasing constrained-union tower to the shifted I_R-smash-power Adams tower, with n=0 map v^smash ell.

C_VERTEX_COHERENCE.statement: The representable vertex diagram turns one chosen R-nullhomotopy on G into a nullhomotopy in Fun(Delta,Sp), hence a factorization through the objectwise quotient Q.

C_UNION_COLLAPSE.statement: The sliced quotient map is the strict zero natural transformation in all simplex degrees j<n on the entire constrained union, giving a coherent null cone after inverting the objectwise equivalence to the constant source.

C_UNIT_CUBE_FIBER.statement: The fiber of S -> holim over nonempty subsets A of [n] of R^smash |A| is I_R^smash n, with the fiber inclusion the smash of the n inclusions.

C_OBJECTWISE_RESTRICTIONS.statement: Each product stratum with n specified G coordinates separately admits a lift through I_R^smash n by smashing a chosen lift on those coordinates.

C_OBJECTWISE_ROUTE_OBSTRUCTION.statement: Objectwise nullity does not imply a null coherent cone: holim(0 -> Sigma HZ <- 0) is HZ and its identity cone has zero components.

C_FIXED_PRIME_CUTOFF.statement: At each fixed prime p, the MU_(p) exponent of tau_<k S_(p) is o(k), equivalently giving the uniform Adams-filtration vanishing cutoff for all connective p-local spectra.

C_CELL_TRUNCATION.statement: Maps from a finite spectrum with upper cell degree D to a (D+1)-connective spectrum vanish; truncation below k>D detects maps to the p-local sphere.

C_BP_UNIT_CONNECTIVITY.statement: At odd p the unit-preserving MU_(p) to BP map transfers lifts to I_BP, which is (2p-3)-connective.

C_FILTERED_PRODUCT.statement: For finite pointed CW pairs and a sphere-valued map with MU-null restriction, the smash power is eventually stably null on the union with at least ceil(ell/2) restricted factors.

C_POINT_TEST_PRODUCTS.statement: The relative point tests of Cartesian products, including sparse unions, identify with smash products of the relative point tests.

C_COORDINATE_THICKENING.statement: Coordinate-complement thickening preserves the required connectivity and cofiber control for the finite coordinate arrangements.

C_BOX_DUALITY.statement: Local box pairs have the claimed stable duality, including the variance and compatibility needed to identify avoidance obstructions with point tests.

C_STABLE_AVOIDANCE.statement: For a finite polyhedron P, point-test vanishing, dim Z<=M-q and dim P<=2q-5 yield a displacement less than 1/2 avoiding Z, with the prescribed compatibility.

C_BOUNDARY_RESTORATION.statement: Radial normalization of a sufficiently small avoidance perturbation creates boundary slots while preserving each entire original boundary-slot vector.

C_BATCH_VANISHING.statement: MU point-test vanishing on Z_an implies sphere point-test vanishing for sufficiently large batches on Z_H with H=floor(an ell/4).

C_BOUNDARY_COMPRESSION.statement: MU-null sparse point tests yield arbitrarily large powers with at least (a/8)un boundary slots, preserving original boundary slots, by padding in the stable avoidance range.

C_FRAMED_TORUS.statement: Construct the framed embedded product of p two-tori in a small (2p+1)-cube and the rank-p sum of degree-one line bundles with product Chern number one.

C_TORUS_MU.statement: A single slot-bundle embedding over the full sparse torus locus into rank K<2pn forces the supported MU point test to vanish.

C_FINITE_PARAMETER_REDUCTION.statement: For arbitrary compact metrizable parameters, preserve the cube-valued map exactly on a finite-polyhedral model while retaining the specified bundle embedding.

C_TORUS_COMPRESSION.statement: For 0<a<1/16, any compact metrizable Y, and K<2pn, the full torus-locus embedding implies arbitrarily large product compressions with (a/8)un boundary slots and exact boundary agreement.

C_NIU_OPEN_TOWER.statement: Niu's open tower theorem supplies towers of arbitrary prescribed height with uniformly small orbit-frequency remainder for the minimal infinite system.

C_UNIFORM_BLOCK_ALLOCATION.statement: Allocate disjoint orbit regions and continuous alignment weights with a uniform bound on bad spaced block starts.

C_FINITE_COORDINATE_COMPRESSION.statement: One finite-dimensional linear map is injective on every coordinate subspace whose support is at most the prescribed q.

C_COMPARISON_BUNDLE.statement: Under the proposition's strict rank budgets, a finite comparison bound produces one continuous rank-<2pn embedding over the entire sparse torus parameter locus.

C_POLYHEDRAL_REFINEMENT.statement: A subordinate map into a q-dimensional finite polyhedron yields a refinement of cover order at most q.

C_COLORED_NERVE.statement: A finite cover admits a subordinate colored finite nerve of dimension no greater than the cover order.

C_FINITE_COVER_RATE.statement: The orders of the orbit joins of a fixed finite cover are subadditive and their normalized values have limit equal to the infimum.

C_PACKET_RECONSTRUCTION.statement: Boundary successes in color packets remove colors in the stated amount while retaining the original carrier support.

C_COVER_BOUND.statement: Every finite comparison bound r forces the orbit-cover rate of every finite open cover to be at most 2r.

C_NIU_UPPER_BOUND.statement: For the free minimal integer action, rc(C(X) crossed Z) <= mdim(X,h)/2.

C_REGULARITY_INPUTS.statement: The cited small-boundary, Jiang-Su stability, comparison, and nuclear-regularity results apply under the stated minimality, infinitude, metrizability, simplicity, nuclearity, and trace conventions.

C_REGULARITY.statement: Zero mean dimension, the small boundary property, Jiang-Su stability, finite nuclear dimension, and nuclear dimension at most one are equivalent for the crossed product in the main theorem.
